item.visible: [!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Property(kofin.id)) | [!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.DBID) + [String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,movie) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,episode) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,musicvideo) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,tvshow) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,season) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,set) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,song) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,album) | String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBTYPE,artist)]] | [String.IsEqual(Container.FolderPath,library://music/kofin/) + String.Contains(ListItem.FileNameAndPath,library://music/kofin/kofinmusic)]]

extension.news: v0.90.0 - First pre-release of the API build for Kodi 22 Piers: the native movie library is written through Kodi's public APIs, with no direct database access - Needs a fresh Kodi profile with an empty video library; an existing kofin (SQL) library is not adopted and sync stays off until the profile is fresh - Native movie sync with metadata refresh, watched/resume reconciliation, repair and removal; deselecting a library removes it in one call - Durable movie snapshots and retry after interrupted sync; incomplete server listings preserve existing content - Imported movies no longer show as in progress before their first detail patch, and the home widgets reload when the library fills from empty - Large libraries import without a scan timeout - Dynamic browsing, streaming and server actions remain available - Native TV/music, downloads, chapter art and SQL maintenance remain disabled pending their API ports - Kodi's own Clean Library run with the add-on disabled removes every synced movie; the next service start imports them again
